Summary Of Position

The Housing Case Manager provides direct support, assessments, and permanent housing coordination for individuals and families living with HIV/AIDS. The position is funded via the HOPWA Program. Housing Opportunities for Persons with AIDS (HOPWA) is a U.S. federal program dedicated to the housing needs of low-income people living with HIV/AIDS (PLWHA). It is administered by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD). Locally, this program is supported through a grant via the City of Charlotte to provide services to an 11-county service area (Anson, Iredell, Cabarrus, Gaston, Lincoln, Mecklenburg, Rowan, and Union in North Carolina, and Chester, Lancaster and York Counties in South Carolina).

The Housing Case Manager duties include but are not limited to: Manage client caseloads, determine federal program eligibility, process short-term rental or utility assistance, and connect clients to essential medical and community care. The Housing Case Manager will build rapport with agencies serving PLWHA throughout the 11-county service area. They will also be responsible for attending (virtually and/or in-person, depending on location and schedule) local Continuum of Care (COC) meetings throughout the service area. Works with Program Manager(s) and the Director of Community Health & Prevention, to track measurable outcomes, and report to partner agencies.
